The '''''Starstalker''''' was a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in use in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] by [[44 ABY]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captained]] by [[Vyn Holpur]], it was part of the task force under the command of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] sent to ally with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] eliminate the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]]. After the task force stopped briefly on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], Taalon decided to leave two ChaseMasters behind, including the ''Starstalker'' and the ''[[Winged Dagger]]'', to meet up with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was bringing along an [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug|asteroid tug]] for assistance in navigating the Maw.

Holpur soon received orders from Taalon passed down from the ''Winged Dagger''{{'s}} Captain, [[Leeha Faal]], to retrieve [[wintrium]] samples from the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients]] on Klatooine. The ''Starstalker'' and her crew [[Violation|beset]] the Fountain, which was defended by primitively-armed [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards. Soon, however, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] arrived to help the Klatooinians, and they attacked the ''Starstalker'', taking the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] captive. The Sith were then brought to trial, and Holpur and the entire crew of the ''Starstalker'' were convicted of violating the Fountain and condemned to [[Death/Legends|death]].
